description: Show one resource instance's attribute values from the current Terraform state (terraform show -json). Does not change state: never locks, never refreshes. Executes code: terraform show starts the provider plugins (credential environment variables removed; a remote state is fetched first by terraform state pull, which gets the backend's variables only if the operator sets TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_ALLOW_BACKEND_CREDENTIALS=1). Redaction is best effort: Terraform's own markers, plus values and map keys equal to a marked one, secret-like names and secret-shaped strings; an unmarked secret with an ordinary name and shape is shown. A footer says what was hidden and why.

address.description: Exact resource instance address as tf_state_addresses prints it, e.g. aws_instance.web[0] or module.db.aws_db_instance.this["primary"]

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized), inside the server's directory or TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

include_null.description: Also list attributes whose value is null

name: tf_show_resource
